findings.title: Security (surface 5): injection
findings.body:
Reachability: Feishu event payload field `event.message.content` -> decoded at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:319 (`_ = common.UnmarshalJsonStr(msg.Content, &content)`) -> `text` built at line 320 and persisted as `RawText` at line 334 -> `parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommand(ctx, text)` at line 358 -> embedded verbatim as the user-role chat message at service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:286 -> POSTed to the chat/completions endpoint at service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:349; the LLM's structured output then determines target account, commission rate, withdrawal flag and gift-credit amount of the pending action executed via `model.AddAffPromotionUsers` / `model.GrantAdminCredits`.
Note: Prompt injection: chat text is sent unescaped to the LLM as a user instruction, and the model's reply steers the proposed plan (which account gets promotion/commission/withdrawal changes and up to 1,000,000 gift credits). Realistic vector is indirect injection: a whitelisted Root operator pastes or replies to third-party/group content. Mitigations exist but do not break the path: sender whitelist + live Root role check (authorizeFeishuFinanceAgentOperator), 500-rune cap, strict json_schema plus server-side field validation (validateFeishuFinanceAgentCommandJSON), deterministic numeric bounds in buildFeishuFinanceAgentPlan, and a human confirmation card echoing the raw text with injection warnings (feishuFinanceAgentInjectionWarningText); the final gate is the operator noticing the mismatch on the card.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

notes: Verification statements (not counted as claims): 20 new/updated tests covering plan building, full confirm flow, duplicate clicks, non-initiator/demoted Root, cancel/expiry, stranger handling, SDK event and card callback conversion, re-click while executing, crash recovery, fresh-record protection, json_schema-to-json_object fallback, command JSON field validation, injection warnings, replay re-authentication, fencing version, parsing recovery, and withdrawal current value; `go build ./...` and `go test ./service ./model ./router ./controller` reportedly pass; three command classes retested with a real DeepSeek model (`deepseek-v4.1-flash`); an end-to-end smoke with a real Feishu app and real model was reportedly completed locally.

Configuration is provided via environment variables `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_APP_ID`, `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_APP_SECRET`, `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_LLM_BASE_URL`, `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_LLM_API_KEY`, `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_LLM_MODEL`, and optional `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE`; the Feishu console must enable events `im.message.receive_v1` and `card.action.trigger` plus permissions `im:message:send_as_bot`, `im:message.p2p_msg:readonly`, `im:message.group_at_msg:readonly`.

Minor review-handling assertions not elevated to claims: model returns only raw quota with credit formatting moved to the service display layer; `ErrFeishuFinanceAgentBadCallback` is converted to an error toast at the WS card callback layer; the reply on parse failure was changed to '请重新发送指令' (please resend the command).
The author explicitly states the threat model requires Root-side acceptance before relying on it.
The author notes a local SQLite development issue with glebarez v1.10 restart DDL, stated as unrelated to this PR (production uses PostgreSQL).
No reviewer comments were supplied in the input, so maintainer overlap could not be assessed beyond the empty field.
